description.narrative: The Community Resilience to Vulnerabilities (CRV) activity addresses a key U.S. foreign policy objective to prevent violent extremism (PVE). CRV has two main components: 1) Enhance the resilience of vulnerable Azerbaijani communities that are susceptible to violent extremism; and 2) Counter trafficking in persons through policy support and direct support to victims through shelters. In these shelters women and children are provide basic needs as well as counseling and job skills training.
